# Nevatal URL Shortener

> Create, manage and resolve short links with click analytics.

## Endpoints
- Homepage: https://url.nevatal.id/
- API: https://url.nevatal.id/health/
- API Catalog: https://url.nevatal.id/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent Card: https://url.nevatal.id/.well-known/agent-card.json
- AI Catalog: https://url.nevatal.id/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- Authentication Guide: https://url.nevatal.id/auth.md
